race.title: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: DANSEUSE 's debut third at Newcastle in May has worked out well so she could be worth chancing on her first run since. It shouldn't be too long before Bintnaseefa and Maneater are winning one of these so are obvious threats, while Don't Hurry Love is worth a second look on her belated return. DANSEUSE (IRE) BINTNASEEFA MANEATER
race.bettingForecast: Maneater (3/1), Danseuse (7/2), Bintnaseefa (9/2), Allaire (6/1), Don't Hurry Love (6/1), Saaffya (8/1), Seacole (12/1), Triumph (25/1), Pure Theory (50/1), Sparkling Water (50/1)
